snippet.title: 4:AM Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
At 4:AM, the city wakes up without rules.
Light is no longer safety.
The Yellow has changed everything.

In 4:AM, you play as Aila, navigating a near future city where survival depends on observation, improvisation, and knowing when to disappear. Copy objects from the environment. Reposition debris. Turn everyday materials into tools. Adapt under pressure.
 
There is no single solution.
Only the one you create.

4:AM is coming in late 2026.
Wishlist now and follow for more:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537270/4AM/

#4AM #IndieGame #StealthGame #GameDev #CinematicGame
